The agent reported “English” as displayed language, but screenshots provide no support and there is no evidence of navigation to confirm language. Score reduced as unsupported.

criteria.criterion: Stop after recording requested information (stopping condition)
criteria.final_justification: Although the agent’s final response stops after presenting the requested fields, the response includes multiple unsupported claims (publisher/language/topics/download options) without evidence they were actually checked. Still, the agent did not continue with extra actions beyond the requested scope, so minimal credit for stopping behavior is appropriate.
